def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    color_cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,3,7)]
    # The marked shape uses the unique non-background color; infer source color and pattern bbox.
    colors={g[r][c] for r,c in color_cells}
    if len(colors)!=1: return g
    color=next(iter(colors))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    # A placement is an occurrence on zero cells. Mark every matched occurrence.
    marked=set()
    for dr in range(h-(max(r for r,c in shape)+1)+1):
      for dc in range(w-(max(c for r,c in shape)+1)+1):
        cells={(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in shape}
        if all(g[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells): marked |= cells
    for r,c in marked: g[r][c]=color
    return g

src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0)
    if not counts:
        return g
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)  # the rare marked pattern color
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in points), min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    maxr = max(r for r, c in shape)
    maxc = max(c for r, c in shape)
    marked = set()
    for dr in range(h-maxr):
        for dc in range(w-maxc):
            cells = [(dr+r, dc+c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(g[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                marked.update(cells)
    for r, c in marked:
        g[r][c] = color
    return g
'''
